title: Staff Site Reliability & Platform Engineer
text:
About Nimbus Cloud Systems
Nimbus Cloud Systems provides mission-critical developer workflow and deployment infrastructure for over 6,000 enterprise engineering organizations. Our platform teams run multi-region compute fleets where reliability, security, and developer velocity reinforce one another.

The Role
We are seeking a Staff Site Reliability & Platform Engineer to lead our Core Compute & Reliability architecture. You will own our multi-cluster container orchestration platform, multi-account cloud provisioning, observability stack, and incident management practices across global regions.

What You Will Do
- Architect and operate production multi-cluster Kubernetes environments supporting hundreds of microservices at four-nines availability.
- Evolve modular Infrastructure as Code using HashiCorp Terraform across Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud Platform.
- Build and scale unified observability stacks with Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry distributed tracing.
- Write custom operators, controllers, and platform CLI automation tools in Go and Python.
- Partner with product engineering leadership to define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets that govern release velocity and platform reliability.
- Lead 24/7 on-call incident response for high-severity outages and champion a blameless postmortem culture.
- Design multi-region disaster recovery, active-active failover, and regular chaos engineering game days.

Requirements (Must-Haves)
- 6+ years in Site Reliability or Platform Engineering operating multi-cluster Kubernetes in production.
- Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code using HashiCorp Terraform across Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud Platform.
- Hands-on experience building and operating observability stacks with Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry distributed tracing.
- Proficiency in Go or Python for building custom operators, controllers, or platform CLI automation tools.
- Experience defining SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets to govern release velocity and platform reliability.
- Track record of leading 24/7 on-call incident response and driving a blameless postmortem culture.
- Experience designing multi-region disaster recovery, active-active failover, and chaos engineering game days.

Nice-to-Haves
- Experience with service mesh and eBPF networking using Istio or Cilium for mTLS and zero-trust traffic policies.
- Proven impact in cloud FinOps cost optimization, Spot instance fleet management, and Reserved capacity planning.
- Experience operating bare-metal data centers, BGP/ASN peering, and hardware kernel bypass (DPDK/SR-IOV).
